latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-reach, enabling internet interaction across 13+ platforms.

- Supports searching, reading, and posting on Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu (小红书), Douyin (抖音), WeChat Articles, LinkedIn, Boss直聘, RSS, Exa web search, and arbitrary web pages.
- Provides usage command examples and guides for each supported platform.
- Adds troubleshooting instructions and workspace rules.
- Allows configuration and setup of platform channels.
